state.description: Batches keyed by B- id; amount and payment count are computed from payments.
Merchant profile (merchant), id counter (counters), synthetic FX table (fx), fee and route-minimum schedule (fees), optional scan bound (limits).
Payment id to batch id, for GET /v1/payments/{paymentId}.
Payout accounts keyed <recipientId>:<accountId>; only last four digits of account numbers.

operations.description: List merchant balances, optionally of one kind (GET /v1/balances, GET /v1/balances/{kind}); includes virtual serverTime.
Create an open batch, optionally with payments (POST /v1/batches).
Delete an open batch and its payments (DELETE /v1/batches/{batchId}).
Lock exchange rates and fees for an open batch for 90 minutes of virtual time (POST /v1/batches/{batchId}/generate-quote).
Retrieve a batch with its computed amount and payment count (GET /v1/batches/{batchId}).
List batches with search, filters, ordering and page-number paging (GET /v1/batches).
Check quote, route minimums and funds, then settle the batch: each payment processed or failed, balance debited (POST /v1/batches/{batchId}/start-processing).
Summarise a batch by payout method: counts, fees, sending and debit amounts (GET /v1/batches/{batchId}/summary).
Update an open batch's description, tags or (while empty) currency (PATCH /v1/batches/{batchId}).
Add a pending payment to an open batch (POST /v1/batches/{batchId}/payments).
Delete a pending payment from an open batch (DELETE /v1/batches/{batchId}/payments/{paymentId}).
Retrieve a payment by batch path or by payment id alone (GET /v1/batches/{batchId}/payments/{paymentId}, GET /v1/payments/{paymentId}).
List a batch's payments with status filter, search and paging (GET /v1/batches/{batchId}/payments).
Update a pending payment in an open batch (PATCH /v1/batches/{batchId}/payments/{paymentId}).
Add a payout method (bank-transfer, paypal, check, venmo) to a recipient (POST /v1/recipients/{recipientId}/accounts).
Disable a payout account (DELETE /v1/recipients/{recipientId}/accounts/{accountId}).
Retrieve one payout account, including disabled ones (GET /v1/recipients/{recipientId}/accounts/{accountId}).
List a recipient's active payout accounts, primary first (GET /v1/recipients/{recipientId}/accounts).
Update a payout account or make it primary (PATCH /v1/recipients/{recipientId}/accounts/{accountId}).
Create a recipient (payee), optionally with payout accounts (POST /v1/recipients).
Archive a recipient (DELETE /v1/recipients/{recipientId}).
Retrieve a recipient with its active payout accounts (GET /v1/recipients/{recipientId}).
List recipients with search, filters, ordering and page-number paging (GET /v1/recipients).
Update recipient profile fields, or restore an archived recipient with status active (PATCH /v1/recipients/{recipientId}).

connections.title: Trolley REST API v1 subset (sandbox merchant) served by this Tool
connections.instructions: Pass these to your test process only. Send `Authorization: prsign <TROLLEY_ACCESS_TOKEN>` (or `Bearer <token>`) to TROLLEY_API_BASE_URL + /v1/...; the token is compared exactly and no HMAC signature or X-PR-Timestamp is checked, so official SDKs that sign requests cannot authenticate unmodified.
